text:
oliver: Heads-up for the release train: due to a regulatory audit next week were introducing a temporary release freeze window and a staged slow-roll pattern for large model weight updates. Freeze window: Thu 00:00 UTC -> Mon 06:00 UTC for the next 3 cycles.

maia: To clarify: the freeze applies only to schema changes, model weight swaps >2GB, and infra migrations. Hotfixes and security patches still go through the exception flow.

toni: New staged slow-roll pattern for big weight swaps: rollout in four stages (1%, 5%, 25%, 70%) with a minimum 30m observation at each stage. Automatic halt if latency p99 increases by >12% or error-rate rises by >0.3%.

devrel: Will this affect demos or conference staging environments? We need a plan to keep demo traffic isolated.

oliver: demo/stage clusters are excluded by default but you'll need to request a temporary exception if you want production routing to demos. Open a ticket in #release-exceptions with expected traffic and rollback plan.

sre-bot: :rotating_light: Exception flow reminder: post to #release-exceptions, include ENG-LEAD approval and SRE sign-off. Auto-notify will ping oncall if staged rollout halts.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Scheduled: release-train/v2024.12 - freeze window starts Thu 00:00 UTC. Owners: oliver, toni. Link: https://console.redwood.example/releases/2024.12

maia: We'll publish the full list of affected routes and the staged-rollout config snippet to the release notes today. If you own critical routes and want them excluded from staged slow-roll, DM me by EOD tomorrow.

toni: Quick ops note: oncall will run an automated perf sweep 1 hour before stage 2 and stage 3. If you want extra checks (mem leak scans, kv cache warmups) add them to your exception ticket.

oliver: Thank you all. This is temporary to satisfy the audit cadence and reduce midroll instability. Reach out if questions.
